title: Per-process LCI mapping overrides (processes/<id>/lca/mappings.yaml)
description: A process's own exchange overrides for build_lci.py, kept with the process (ADR 0022). Keys are the dataset exchange keys (<kind>:<id>) without the process id; each entry has the schema of an `exchanges:` entry of lci/mappings.yaml (schemas/lci-mappings.schema.json). The build merges them with lci/mappings.yaml, which keeps the shared vocabulary (technosphere, biosphere, proxies, allocation, ...); the same exchange in both files is an error.

exchanges.description: Overrides by "<key>" of this process's datasets: `use` a technosphere entry of lci/mappings.yaml, give the exchange's `chemical` slug, a `dataset` (an Atlas producer), `atlas: false`, or a `properties_reason`.
